title: 第一卷 第17章 强势的穆婉云梦儿加入天璇第一卷 第18章 善良的宫主
content_zh:
秦逸对秦沧放出狠话。
反正他就算不说这些，秦沧要杀他的想法也很强烈。
当然，就算秦沧愿意算了，秦逸也不会答应算了。
所以干脆气一气秦沧。
就当稍微收一点利息。
死了儿子又死了女儿的秦沧，被秦逸这些话刺激，心中那股怒火与杀意，再一次不受控制的爆发了。
“小兔崽子，给我去死！”
秦沧怒吼。
恐怖的气息，轰然爆发。
他瞬间前冲。
刹那间，天璇宫之主穆婉，便身形一闪，挡在了秦逸面前，长剑出鞘，剑光爆闪，斩出一道剑气劈向了秦沧。
秦沧一掌拍打，击碎了剑气。
可紧接着，负责此次考核的天星武院长老也身形一闪，挡在了秦沧的前方。
再然后，广场后方，天星武院内部，爆发出一道道强横的气息。
秦沧只能停下。
大夏皇朝的老太监急忙冲到了秦沧身边，低声道：“秦家主冷静一点，这里是苍星武院。”
秦沧满脸横肉都在抽动。
他的目光，越过众人，死死地盯着秦逸。
“你以为加入天星武院，有天璇宫主护着你，就能肆意妄为了吗？小兔崽子，你别得意忘形，你迟早会重新落入我的手里，到时，我要你好看！”
丢下这句话，秦沧带着无穷怒火与杀气，甩袖转身，离开天星城。

大夏皇朝的老太监，则是看向广场上所有参加考核活着出来的年轻人，道：“如果有人提供我们大夏皇朝十三皇子之死的线索，必有重赏！”
说完，老太监也带人离去，他得赶紧回大夏皇宫，将夏非凡殒命的消息，汇报给当今夏皇。
………
负责考核的天星武院长老，看向被穆婉护住的秦逸。
这位长老的神色显得颇为复杂，然后道：“按照天星武院考核规则，秦逸获得第一名，奖励三千星辰点。”
“第二名王冲，奖励两千星辰点。”
“第三名李云霄，奖励一千星辰点。”
……
“第十名张涛，奖励三百星辰点。”
“接下来，此次考核前五百名，跟随老夫，进入天星武院，每个人可以自行选择天星武院七宫加入。”
穆婉道：“秦逸闯七星塔时，就选择了天璇宫，所以不必再走这繁琐的流程了，我先带秦逸走了。”
长老点头，道：“自然可以。”
穆婉身形一闪，便带着秦逸离去。
排名前五百之人，则是被天星武院的长老带走。
content_en:
Qin Yi said harsh words to Qin Cang.
Anyway, even if he didn't say this, Qin Cang still had a strong desire to kill him.
Of course, even if Qin Cang is willing to let it go, Qin Yi will not agree to let it go.
So just make Qin Cang angry.
Just charge a little interest.
Qin Cang, who had lost both his son and his daughter, was stimulated by Qin Yi's words, and the anger and murderous intent in his heart broke out uncontrollably again.
"You little bastard, go to hell!"
Qin Cang roared.
The terrifying aura suddenly erupted.
He rushed forward instantly.
In an instant, Mu Wan, the master of Tianxuan Palace, stepped in front of Qin Yi, unsheathed his long sword, the sword light flashed, and struck Qin Cang with a sword energy.
Qin Cang slapped his palm and shattered the sword energy.
But then, the elder of Tianxing Martial Arts Academy who was in charge of this assessment also flashed and stood in front of Qin Cang.
Then, behind the square, inside the Tianxing Martial Academy, powerful auras erupted.
Qin Cang could only stop.
The old eunuch of the Great Xia Dynasty rushed to Qin Cang's side and whispered: "Master Qin, calm down, this is Cangxing Martial Academy."
Qin Cang's face was twitching.
His eyes crossed the crowd and stared at Qin Yi.
"Do you think that by joining the Tianxing Martial Academy and having the Master of Tianxuan Palace protecting you, you can do whatever you want? Little bastard, don't get carried away. Sooner or later, you will fall into my hands again. When the time comes, I want you to look good!"
After saying these words, Qin Cang turned around and left Tianxing City with endless anger and murderous intent.
The old eunuch of the Great Xia Dynasty looked at all the young people in the square who had participated in the assessment and survived, and said: "If anyone provides clues to the death of the thirteenth prince of our Great Xia Dynasty, there will be a heavy reward!"
After saying that, the old eunuch also took the people away. He had to quickly return to the Daxia Palace and report the news of Xia Feifan's death to the current Emperor Xia.
………
The elder of Tianxing Martial Arts Academy who was in charge of the assessment looked at Qin Yi who was being protected by Mu Wan.
The elder's expression looked quite complicated, and then he said: "According to the assessment rules of Tianxing Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yi won first place and was rewarded with three thousand star points."
"The second place Wang Chong will be rewarded with two thousand star points."
"Third place Li Yunxiao will be rewarded with one thousand star points."
…
"Zhang Tao, who ranks tenth, will be rewarded with three hundred star points."
"Next, the top 500 people in this assessment will follow me and enter the Tianxing Martial Arts Academy. Everyone can choose the Seventh Palace of the Tianxing Martial Arts Academy to join."
Mu Wan said: "Qin Yi chose Tianxuan Palace when he broke into the Seven Star Tower, so there is no need to go through this complicated process. I will take Qin Yi away first."
The elder nodded and said, "Of course."
Mu Wan flashed and left with Qin Yi.
The top five hundred people were taken away by the elders of Tianxing Martial Academy.
